meta.description: Book the free assessment: a 30-minute conversation about your problem, what you expect, and whether Imbra is a good fit.

label: Free assessment
heading: Book a call.
sub: Thirty minutes to describe the problem, hear how we would approach it, and decide whether we are a good fit for each other. Neither side is obliged to proceed.

booking.label: Choose a time →
booking.note: Booking opens our own server at cloud.imbra.io in a new tab. Nothing is loaded into this page, so no cookies are set here.
booking.privacy: Call scheduling runs on our own Nextcloud at cloud.imbra.io, hosted for us by Hetzner in Germany. This page only links to it, and loads none of its code, so nothing is set in your browser until you follow that link. What you enter there — your name, email address and what you write about your problem — reaches us directly and is not passed to any other company. See Hetzner's Privacy Policy.

sections.title: What the call is
paragraphs: A conversation about your needs and our suitability. You describe what is failing or what you want built, and we say whether we can help, how we would start, and what it would cost.
It is free and carries no obligation on either side.

sections.title: What it is not
paragraphs: It is not a technical investigation. Any detailed analysis of your systems is scoped, time-limited, priced and approved before work starts. Rates are on the pricing page.
It is not a support channel and carries no response-time promise.

sections.title: What to bring
paragraphs: Your company and its website. We read up on both before the call, so the time goes on your problem rather than on context.
A short description of what is failing, the systems involved (protocols, controllers, historians, versions where you know them), and the outcome you want.
Do not send logs, credentials, drawings or anything confidential before a mutual NDA is in place.

alt.label: Rather write first?
alt.sub: Send a message or email instead. We answer in the same terms, and can book a call from there.
